evidence.r1: The permit platter puts campsite information and availability rows on a large glass content panel.
evidence.r2: The permit platter is below the trigger, and its Reserve and Close buttons read as fills rather than stacked glass.
evidence.r3: The planner, permit trigger and opened permit platter are the only substantial glass regions.
evidence.r4: The planner and permit platter share a pale, cloudy regular-glass appearance.
evidence.r5: No clear-glass surface is visible; the planner and platter are diffusely frosted.
evidence.r6: The open permit view retains the pink Check permit background alongside the red Reserve background.
evidence.r7: The normal planner and permit platter visibly carry diffuse photographic colour rather than flat opaque replacements.
evidence.r8: The planner and platter use fixed rounded corners, while the permit actions are capsules.
evidence.r9: The permit platter has pill-like interior information rows whose corner arcs do not follow the outer panel.
evidence.r10: The bordered Close action and standalone Check permit action have capsule outlines.
evidence.r11: Trip parameters share one planner background and the permit action occupies a separate group.
evidence.r12: The planner and permit actions are text-only; no icon-button group shares their backgrounds.
evidence.r13: The planner material encloses the whole control strip rather than individual value labels.
evidence.r14: The planner fields form one continuous material, with deliberate separation from the distant permit trigger.
evidence.r15: The scrolled trail and conditions captures show one soft top-edge fade beneath the floating planner.
evidence.r16: The mountain image remains behind the planner and permit action even in the scrolled captures.
evidence.r17: Trail rows and their labels pass beneath the resting planner in the second-screen capture.
evidence.r18: The planner is readable in the light capture, but no dark-state capture establishes the required contrast in both modes.
evidence.r19: The reduced-transparency planner remains readable, but increased-contrast and reduced-motion operation are not shown.
evidence.r20: The park photograph and contour field reach the window edges behind the floating controls.
evidence.r21: The first-view heading clears the planner and the scrolled upper edge extends the mountain background behind it.
evidence.r22: The planner and opened permit platter show material rims without a distinct extra backing panel.
evidence.r23: The open permit still does not show emergence, morphing or pointer-local press feedback.
evidence.r24: The planner labels and permit labels are monochrome; trail-status colours live in the table.
evidence.r25: The dark planner and permit labels remain distinct from their pale photographic material backgrounds.
